Also copying Jacob from our legal team for contract redlines. If you need an internal SOW for usage patterns I can pull it together.

Thanks,

I attached a marked-up MSA that reflects the term swap and an addendum (Exhibit C) template for the capacity schedule.

- Legal redline pass (Markus) on the attached MSA v4_marked.pdf

- DocuSign path: Priyom to prepare signature routing once redlines are agreed

Thanks Ben. Elena — quick legal notes inline/high level so procurement isn't surprised: 

- Term & pricing: 24-month term is fine; we'll keep price protection for first 12 months. We'll require the committed tokens/throughput numbers in Exhibit C to be explicit (units, measurement window, and renewal uplift mechanics).
- Liability cap: Redwood prefers cap at 12 months of fees; customer requested 24 — counter with 12 months but offer to carve out data breach/higher liability for gross negligence.
- Data processing: add DPA references; we will include standard DPA as Schedule 2 and option for a signed DPA if their legal team requires it.
- Audit rights: limit to once-per-year scoped audit with redwood-provided SOC2 evidence in lieu of broad audit rights.
- Termination for convenience: we'll accept, but require 90-day notice and a pro-rated true-up for committed capacity.

I'll attach specific redline notes in the PDF. Priyom — once Elena confirms uplift we'll prepare the signature routing and the canary signing sequence for dedicated capacity (if they opt for dedicated later).

Markus
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
Attachment referenced: Redwood_MSA_v4_marked.pdf (see comments)
From: Jacob Stern <jacob.stern@oscarlabs.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Elena Park <ep@summitai.com>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 13:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + uplift: draft PO and scope question

Hi all — Jacob on behalf of SummitAI legal. Apologies for the delay; attached are SummitAI's redlines. High level:

- Liability: we can accept a 12-month cap but need an exception for intellectual property infringement and will want an escrow-style remediation clause for model-privacy incidents.
- Audit/data: prefer a 30-day data deletion window following termination and broader audit visibility for data flows affecting regulated datasets (we can narrow the scope if necessary).
- SLA ask: we need a latency SLA for the burst profile in Exhibit C (p95 under 300ms for batch inference and p95 under 1200ms for streaming in region us-west-2).
- Pricing: we will sign for 24 months only if the first 12 months are price-protected and the second 12 months have a capped increase (no more than 6% YoY).

I attached SummitAI_redlines.docx and included comments next to the relevant clauses. Let us know which items are deal-breakers and which we can triage to product/ops.

Jacob Stern
Legal Counsel, SummitAI

Elena/Jacob — appreciate the detailed redlines, that helps. Quick operational plan & asks so we have a clear mutual action plan: 

1) Capacity: Elena to confirm final uplift number (you flagged 2.5x; please confirm today). Lauren will update OrderForm_ExhibitC_v2.xlsx (SKU rows + billing contact) once you confirm.

2) Legal redlines: Markus will do a single consolidated pass on SummitAI_redlines.docx and Redwood_MSA_v4_marked.pdf. Targets: return consolidated comments by COB Monday. Key items we will try to resolve quickly: liability carveouts, data deletion window (Markus proposes 60 days but can negotiate to 30 for regulated subsets), and SLA language for burst profile — Ops will propose achievable p95s by EOD Monday.

3) Pricing term: Redwood confirms price protection for first 12 months. For months 13–24 we can accept a contract cap (<=6% increase) provided the commitment in Exhibit C is met.

4) Signature path: Priyom to prepare DocuSign envelope and route to Elena -> Jacob -> Ben -> Contracts for Redwood signature. Priyom, please also add a parallel email routing to finance@redwood.com for invoice kick-off.

5) Timeline: our goal is DocuSign by next Wednesday 26 May so you have continuity. If SummitAI needs a later activation date we can show that on the order form.

I'll host a 30-minute sync tomorrow at 10am PT to walk through outstanding redlines if helpful — invite to follow.

Ben
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
